{{Quote|Even when his men were killed at the Battle of High Ridge, he lived in the snow, hunting wampas with a spear made from the icicle.|Captain Eth|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Battle of High Ridge''' was a skirmish between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Hailstorm Brotherhood]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Although casualties were great from both sides, both Master [[Sav]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Eth]] survived the battle.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1stm}}
